{{Quote|You want a ride in? We're securing the HoloNet center. Don't want to break it before we can send out all those uplifting Republic messages, do we?|Tel|<ref name="TrueColors" />}}
'''Tel'''<ref name="TrueColors" /> was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="CloneTrooper">Tel uses [[Armor tally|armor tallies]] and the term "[[Mongrel/Legends|mongrel]]" in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', which ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established both to be used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], making Tel a clone trooper.</ref> [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[35th Infantry]] who fought in the [[Battle of Gaftikar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]]. During the battle he brought [[Omega Squad]] with him to take out the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] center in [[Eyat]]. Before going into Eyat City, he told the Omegas of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], whom he considered a good officer, for a non-[[Cloning/Legends|clone]].<ref name="TrueColors" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We've got mongrel officers now, for fierfek's sake, and that one only got through the Academy because his dad's some ranking captain.|Tel, expressing disdain towards mongrel officers|<ref name="TrueColors" />}}
Tel appeared in the novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'',<ref name="TrueColors" /> released on [[October 30]], [[2007]].<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/180092/true-colors-star-wars-legends-republic-commando-by-karen-traviss|text=True Colors: Star Wars Legends (Republic Commando)}}</ref> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released on [[December 9]], [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin-TCSWE">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> states in Tel's entry that he was a nonclone officer,<ref name="TCSWE-Tel">{{CSWECite|III|228|Tel}}</ref> however, this is contradicted by other information found within the encyclopedia. The encyclopedia states that [[Armor tally|armor tallies]] contained a clone trooper's identification,<ref name="TCSWE-Tallies">{{CSWECite|I|42|armor tally}}</ref> and ''Republic Commando: True Colors'' establishes that Tel has an armor tally. Furthermore, within the novel Tel uses the term "[[Mongrel/Legends|mongrel]],"<ref name="TrueColors" /> which the encyclopedia establishes to be a slang term used by clone troopers to describe the nonclone humans given leadership roles.<ref name="TCSWE-Mongrel">{{CSWECite|II|327|mongrel}}</ref> Since Tel expresses disapproval towards mongrel officers, this article assumes that Tel is not a mongrel officer, and is instead a clone trooper.<ref name="TrueColors" />
